facts.text: RACER (Robotic Autonomy in Complex Environments with Resiliency) is a DARPA program pursuing high-speed autonomous military ground-vehicle driving over unstructured off-road terrain; its simulation arm built a very large virtual off-road environment.
facts.quote: RACER is a program of the United States defense research agency DARPA to make military ground vehicles drive themselves fast across rough off-road terrain, and its simulation arm built a very large virtual off-road environment.

facts.text: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) funds high-risk research for the United States military.
facts.quote: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) funds high-risk research for the United States military.

facts.text: The companion RACER-Sim effort was announced in January 2022 with Duality Robotics and Intel Federal as its two prime contractors.
facts.quote: The companion RACER-Sim effort, announced in January 2022 with Duality Robotics and Intel Federal as the two prime contractors

facts.text: RACER-Sim had a reported Phase 1 budget of about USD 6 million.
facts.quote: a reported Phase 1 budget of about USD 6 million

facts.text: RACER-Sim tasked one team with building an 80 square kilometer (20 km by 4 km) virtual off-road environment on a digital-twin simulation platform.
facts.quote: tasked one team with building an 80 square kilometer (20 km by 4 km) virtual off-road environment on a digital-twin simulation platform

facts.text: NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory contracted the same digital-twin simulation platform used for RACER-Sim for RACER Phase II in September 2024.
facts.quote: NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory contracted the same platform for RACER Phase II in September 2024

facts.text: The booklet records RACER as documented government use of an off-road simulator focused on high-speed military driving rather than close-quarters work with people.
facts.quote: The booklet records this as documented government use of an off-road simulator, with a focus on high-speed military driving rather than on close-quarters work with people

facts.text: The booklet found no publicly documented military ground-vehicle automatic-braking safety case with quantified simulation substitution.
facts.quote: no publicly documented military ground-vehicle automatic-braking safety case with quantified simulation substitution

facts.text: RACER was classified as "not found" as a validation case in Chapter 2 of the booklet.
facts.quote: RACER itself was "not found" as a validation case in Chapter 2

facts.text: RACER was classified as "not verified" as a lead in Chapter 13 of the booklet.
facts.quote: "not verified" as a lead in Chapter 13

facts.text: RACER demonstrates that large off-road virtual environments can be built and that a government customer has paid for one, supporting the feasibility of virtual job sites.
facts.quote: RACER shows that large off-road virtual environments can be built and that a government customer has paid for one, which supports the feasibility of virtual job sites

facts.text: RACER offers no evidence about accepting simulation as safety evidence for braking.
facts.quote: it offers no evidence about accepting simulation as safety evidence for braking
